elements.description:
Rows of an import, checked before they land: cell problems in words, duplicates by a key with Keep this and Merge,
filter tabs with counts, cells edited in place, skip and restore, and Import once nothing's left to fix.

properties.name: description
properties.description: A quiet line under the heading – the file, or where the rows go

properties.name: columns
properties.description: The columns, in order, with their type and whether they're required

properties.name: rows
properties.description: The rows – the value. Changed by editing, skipping, keeping and merging unless a tc-rows-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: duplicateKey
properties.description: The column whose value makes rows duplicates – an email, an id. None: no duplicate check

properties.name: validate
properties.description: The page's own check per cell, after the built-in ones: the problem in words, or null

properties.name: filter
properties.description: Which rows the table shows. Changed by the tabs unless a tc-filter-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: skipProblems
properties.description: Import leaves out rows with problems and extra duplicates instead of waiting for them. Changed by its checkbox unless a tc-skip-problems-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: pageSize
properties.description: Rows shown at first, and added by Show more rows

properties.name: labels
properties.description: Words the page can rename, merged over defaultImportReviewLabels

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-rows-change
events.description: A cell was edited, or a row skipped, restored, kept or merged ({ rows, change, id }: ImportReviewRowsChange); cancelable – prevented, `rows` stays as it was

events.name: tc-filter-change
events.description: A filter tab was chosen ({ filter }: ImportReviewFilterChange); cancelable – prevented, `filter` stays as it was

events.name: tc-skip-problems-change
events.description: "Skip rows with problems" was switched ({ skipProblems }: ImportReviewSkipProblemsChange); cancelable – prevented, `skipProblems` stays as it was

events.name: tc-import
events.description: Import was pressed with nothing left to fix, or with rows with problems skipped ({ rows, skipped }: ImportReviewImport); cancelable

functions.name: cellProblem
functions.signature: cellProblem(value: string, column: ImportReviewColumn, row: ImportReviewRow, validate?: ImportReviewValidator, labels: Partial<ImportReviewLabels>): string | null
functions.description: A cell's problem in words, or null: required and empty, then the column's type, then the page's own check

functions.name: duplicateGroups
functions.signature: duplicateGroups(rows: ImportReviewRow[], key: string | undefined): ImportReviewRow[][]
functions.description: Groups of rows (not skipped) that share a key value, in the order they first appear; groups of one are left out

props.name: rows
props.description: The rows. Controlled when defined – pass back what onRowsChange reports

props.name: onRowsChange
props.type: (rows: ImportReviewRow[], change: ImportReviewChangeKind, id: string) => void
props.description: A cell was edited, or a row skipped, restored, kept or merged: every row, what was done and to which row

props.name: filter
props.description: Which rows the table shows. Controlled when defined

props.name: skipProblems
props.description: Whether Import leaves out rows with problems and extra duplicates. Controlled when defined

props.name: onImport
props.description: Import was pressed: the rows to import and the rows left out. Return false to say it didn't happen

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: overscroll-behavior: contain
features.without: Scrolling past the end of a list carries on scrolling the page.
